main.description: Provisions a new community: an account on the AppView's PDS, its four spaces, an owner role, and a starter layout of two categories holding one text channel and one voice channel between them. This call runs long enough that progress is also emitted over social.colibri.beta.sync.subscribeEvents.

handlePrefix.description: A slug used for the community handle instead of a generated one.

requiresApprovalToJoin.description: Whether joining produces an application a moderator must approve. Defaults to false.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.description: A community already exists with the requested handle.

errors.name: PdsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView's PDS could not be reached to provision the account.

errors.name: SpacesUnsupported
errors.description: The AppView's PDS does not implement com.atproto.simplespace, so it cannot host community spaces.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A PDS or third-party call the AppView depends on failed.
